plain_english: My grandfather taught me to keep my temper and stay calm. I never saw him lose control, and that quiet strength shaped everything I became.
original_excerpt: From my grandfather Verus I learned good morals and the government of my temper.

plain_english: From my mother, I learned to be generous and to live simply. She showed me that real wealth has nothing to do with how much you spend.
original_excerpt: From my mother, piety and beneficence, and abstinence, not only from evil deeds, but even from evil thoughts; and further, simplicity in my way of living.

plain_english: My teachers showed me that doing the right thing matters more than being praised for it. Work quietly. Let your character speak louder than your reputation.
original_excerpt: From my governor, to be neither of the green nor of the blue party at the games in the Circus, nor a partizan either of the Parmularius or the Scutarius at the gladiators' fights.
